## What happened

The job was parity with what GitHub Actions gave, for both products. It moved
from 3 of 13 capabilities at or above Actions to 7 of 13. The ledger, which is
the one page to open first:
    https://claude.ai/code/artifact/a8363353-7872-4dcd-9d4a-8a33ac3cd325

THE CAUSE OF THE BLOCKED BATTERY WAS NOT WHAT THE LAST PACK THOUGHT. Command 3
was never a code problem. tools/sbe_score.py runs 15 checks; 12 read an external
vault through BROTHERSBE_VAULT, which is set in a personal Claude Code settings
file on this machine and was never set by the workflow. Same commit: 10 PASS /
2 FAIL / 3 NO-DATA locally, 3 PASS / 0 FAIL / 12 NO-DATA under Actions. The
previous session was chasing a gate that could not be won, because one of the
two failures reads finished session records no commit can alter.

TWO WAYS THE RUNNER COULD LIE, both demonstrated with commands and both closed:
an inherited PYTHONPATH plus one untracked sitecustomize.py made a real suite
produce ZERO bytes of output and exit 0, counted as a pass, and 34 of the 52
commands begin with python3; and SBE_TRUSTED_REF was an environment variable, so
the anchor that stops a fork pull request executing code as this user could be
moved by the caller, with nothing ever fetching the ref it trusted.
